CORE MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

2. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 40.5
   C. 10
   D. 81

3. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

5. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)

   B. 1/2

   C. 1

   D. 45

   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 43

   C. 19.7
   D. 25

   A. 23.6

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 105
   C. 30
   D. 44

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 77
   C. 18
   D. 22

18. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)

   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²

22. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)

   C. 400

24. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)

25. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 81

26. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
